title: Exact Rational 4-Volume Flux, Curvature Identity & Rust verify_phi4 Certifier on Hollow 5-Simplex (b4 = 1)

claim_hygiene.what_it_supports: Shows that on the hollow 5-simplex boundary complex with b4 = 1, exact rational LP weak duality certifies that the degree-4 quotient obstruction of G = (-1/6, 1/6, -1/6, 1/6, -1/6, 1/6) is Phi_4([G]) = 1, confirmed by coupling to the Rust omega_functional::phi4 verifier under exact rational arithmetic.
claim_hygiene.what_it_does_not_support: Does not establish continuous differential form de Rham cohomology, smooth spacetime metrics, or quantum field theoretic 4-volume path integral convergence.
claim_hygiene.narrowest_defensible_claim: On the finite 6-vertex, 15-edge, 20-face, 15-tetrahedron, 6-pentachoron hollow 5-simplex boundary complex, the certificate pair (C*, v*) certifies in Q that the degree-4 quotient obstruction is exactly 1 with zero duality gap, and that d3 * d2 = 0, d2 * d1 = 0, and d1 * d0 = 0.
claim_hygiene.next_test_needed: Couple to 4-manifold complexes (b2 >= 2, b4 = 1) to test discrete Pontryagin cup product pairings <F smile F, [M4]> and topological instanton number quantization.
